objective: 扩展现有Agent.ContainerContext immutable public read model，使其从唯一V2 state派生current node/slice/path-relative entry/latest occurrence/evidence revision与Fast availability，供DriverHost后续只读消费

semantic_brief.summary: Buyer：Runtime owner flip已验证，但DriverHost缺少不越权的V2 public read source。扩展既有ContainerTransitionReadModel与Agent.ContainerContext，不公开Graph/live handle，不新建interface/state。缺少latest Fast因设计不保存，显式Unavailable。
core_points: PUBLIC_READ_MODEL != MUTABLE_AUTHORITY；只从唯一V2 state即时派生
LEGACY_TRANSITION != CURRENT_OCCURRENCE；分别可读且不互相替代

change_principles: 先搜索现有Agent public current/transition read surfaces；固定REUSE/EXTEND ContainerTransitionReadModel与Agent.ContainerContext，不创建V2 snapshot service/interface/registry/cache
所有V2字段从_containerRuntimeV2State即时派生；LatestTransitionOccurrence从append-only V2 occurrences取最后值，无mutable latest cache
root CurrentContainer存在但EntryContext为null时，current node/slice/revision/occurrence仍为known，entry fields为known null；没有V2 state时V2 availability显式false/unknown，不从Belief或legacy推断
FastAssessmentAvailability必须表达NotRetained/Unavailable语义，因为production刻意不保存latest Fast assessment；不得新增latest slot或从Graph/Belief推断Fast结果
公开值只允许opaque refs、immutable occurrence value与revision；不得暴露ContainerGraph、ActiveContainerContext、Container、progress、provider、action或recovery handle
新增字段/enum/property必须XML doc和NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION；你不是仓库唯一执行者，不得回退用户/他人dirty-tree修改
acceptance: 真实Agent r5 state投影current semantic/node/slice/revision=SettingsRoot evidence且ActiveExecution=Display；读取不改变V2 state、ActiveContext、progress或trace
multi-entry/verified return投影同一node的不同EntrySource/EntryOccurrence并恢复父entry；无canonical parent/reverse edge字段
root entry known-null与no-V2-state unavailable明确区分；latest V2 occurrence与legacy latest transition分别可读并保持exact binding
Fast assessment availability明确NotRetained/Unavailable，reflection/source guard证明无latest Fast/Slow/trust/correction/checkpoint field
ContainerTransitionReadModel保持immutable value，无Graph/action/goal/recovery/completion/provider API或live Runtime handle
focused read-model/R8/transition/Agent与Architecture tests通过；Runtime/solution build 0 errors；git diff --check通过；AuthorityDelta=NONE、BehaviorDelta=NONE、NET_NEW_MUTABLE_TRUTH=0
forbidden: 禁止修改DriverHost、wire/DTO、Agent reconciliation、Goal/Action/Recovery/progress/Container local evidence或transition classification
禁止新增mutable V2/current/occurrence/assessment owner、latest cache、service、manager、registry或interface
禁止从legacy transition/Belief/reason反推缺失V2字段，禁止修改OpenSpec/docs/tasks/evidence/WorkItem
禁止放宽fail-closed、删除测试或改变现有read field语义取得GREEN
escalation: 若现有ContainerTransitionReadModel无法承载且确需新长期public type/interface，先返回REUSE/EXTEND/REFACTOR/CREATE比较，不自行创建
若read seam需要新增mutable/latest owner或改变Agent/Driver authority，返回AUTHORITY_GATE_REQUIRED
若scope文件有不明并发冲突或失败指向scope外，保留现场并返回Expected/Observed/Gap/FirstDivergence/Owner
